name: Akroma
bossInsult: Enlightenment comes most swiftly at life's end.
bossIntro: I feed my hatred to the righteous and they join my crusade

name: Elesh Norn
bossInsult: Our glorious infection has taken hold.

name: Ghalta
bossIntro: <i>A thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.<i>

name: Griselbrand
bossInsult: Kneel. It is the only thing you were ever worthy of doing before me.
bossIntro: When the power of light fails you, what atrocities might you contemplate to curry favor with darkness?

name: Jin-Gitaxias
bossIntro: The work goes on. The progress is inevitable.
bossInsult: Flesh is a flaw. We are the cure.

name: Kozilek
bossIntro: Your 'truth' is a thin veil over a void that is hungry. I am the hand that pulls the thread.
bossInsult: Your reality is a structure of glass. I am the rock.

name: Lathliss
bossInsult: Even my hatchlings would have ended you faster.
bossIntro: If I command it, my children will burn this world to ash.

name: Lorthos
bossInsult: The deep remembers every failure… and now it remembers you.
bossIntro: Struggle if you must. The ocean always claims what enters it.

name: Nissa
bossIntro: I am Nissa Revane, and I am the soul of this world!
bossInsult: The ground of this plane is not a weapon... But it will defend itself.

name: Urabrask
bossInsult: That Great Work of yours is looking pretty fragile
bossIntro: Large or small, all will toil for the Great Work.

name: Vorinclex
bossIntro: The hunt is the only truth. The predator is the only king.
bossInsult: Submit to the hunger. Become part of the machine.
